meta.description: Second held-out GMPP set for ProjectLens (2016-17 -> 2017-18, 2017-18 -> 2018-19, 2018-19 -> 2019-20). Not for tuning.
meta.yearConvention: year N = the release labelled (N-1)-N; these releases report data as at 30 September of year N-1.

labelRules.contradiction: end date moved >14 days and the narrative says unchanged/the same/on track or on schedule, or names a current end date >14 days from the published one, without stating the actual move
labelRules.explained: end date moved >14 days and the narrative states the change (or the delay that caused it)
labelRules.no-move: published end date identical in both releases (daysMoved = 0)

contradictionTypes.claims-on-track: narrative presents stability as 'on track' / 'on schedule' / 'on time' with no move stated (tuning treated these paraphrases as stability claims)
contradictionTypes.names-different-date: narrative names a current end date >14 days from the published one

meta.matching: These releases publish no stable GMPP ID before 2019-20. Pairs are joined on the exact project name after lower-casing and stripping punctuation, and only when the name is unique in both releases. Departments match (allowing renames, e.g. DH -> DHSC).
meta.narrativeVerbatim: Exact cell text from the current-release CSV (Windows-1252 decoded), including line breaks.
meta.licence: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
